visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a bright, modern restaurant kitchen and dining area. A male chef in a white uniform and tall toque stands behind a metal griddle counter with his arms crossed. A male customer in a yellow t-shirt sits at the counter, and a female waitress in a white shirt and red apron stands beside him. The background features white shelving with bottles and kitchen supplies under soft indoor lighting. (2) The camera shifts to medium close-ups of the customer and the waitress as they engage in a conversation. The waitress holds a digital tablet and a stylus, nodding as the customer gestures with his hands. The lighting remains consistent and bright, highlighting the character's facial expressions of seriousness and inquiry. (3) The chef begins cooking on the griddle, moving his hands to handle pieces of meat and red bell peppers. The waitress stands very close to him, leaning in and occasionally touching his shoulder or arm. They exchange glances and smiles, ignoring the customer who sits in the foreground with a confused and slightly annoyed expression. (4) The chef presents a plate where the meat and vegetables are arranged in a heart shape. The waitress adds green onions with a playful gesture. They both lean towards each other, their faces close, while the customer looks on in disbelief, eventually covering his face as if blinded by their affection.

The BGM remains light and consistent in the background. (3) A distinct metallic 'clang' and a 'thud' SFX mark the start of the cooking phase. The sound of sizzling food becomes the primary ambient texture. The music shifts slightly to a more playful, comedic theme with bouncy synthesizer notes.
